0.description: Interaktiodemo vikailmoituksen sijaintiosiosta. Ei upotettu millekään sivulle. Kentät 7 ja 8 ovat vain demoa varten — poista ne tuotantoversiosta.

fields.label: 112-varoitus (näkyy vain vauriovalinnalla)
fields.content:
Älä lähesty vauriokohtaa

Vaurioitunut johto tai pylväs voi olla hengenvaarallinen. Pidä etäisyyttä ja varoita muita paikalla olijoita. Voit täyttää ilmoituksen turvallisen matkan päästä.

Soita 112

<style id="hn-css">
/* Herrfors Nät — location section for Gravity Forms.
   Every class is prefixed hn-, so nothing here can collide with the theme.

   The custom properties sit on :root rather than on the containers. They were
   scoped at first, which broke the moment the form went on a real page: the 112
   warning and the two demo panels are separate Gravity Forms fields and therefore
   live outside the containers, so var(--hn-danger) resolved to nothing and the
   "Soita 112" button rendered as white text on a transparent background. Field
   order is the editor's to change, so the variables have to be reachable from
   anywhere. The hn- prefix is what keeps that safe. */
:root{
  --hn-navy:#0b2545; --hn-orange:#E05A2B; --hn-teal:#3ABFA1;
  --hn-danger:#C62828; --hn-danger-bg:#FDECEA; --hn-warn:#B26A00; --hn-warn-bg:#FFF6E5;
  --hn-ink:#12203a; --hn-muted:#5a6b85; --hn-line:#d9e0ea; --hn-line-soft:#eaeff5;
  --hn-tap:52px;
}
#hn-loc,#hn-loc2,.hn-112,#hn-ops,#hn-sim{
  font-family:"Mulish",system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif;
  color:var(--hn-ink); font-size:16px; line-height:1.55;
}
#hn-loc *,#hn-loc2 *,.hn-112 *,#hn-ops *,#hn-sim *{box-sizing:border-box}
.hn-hidden{display:none !important}

.hn-head{background:#f7fafc;border:1.5px solid var(--hn-line);border-bottom:0;
  border-radius:10px 10px 0 0;padding:12px 14px}
.hn-head strong{display:block;font-size:15px;font-weight:700}
.hn-head span{display:block;font-size:13px;color:var(--hn-muted);margin-top:2px}
.hn-body{border:1.5px solid var(--hn-line);border-top:1px solid var(--hn-line-soft);
  border-radius:0 0 10px 10px;padding:14px}

.hn-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;
  min-height:var(--hn-tap);width:100%;padding:12px 18px;
  font-family:inherit;font-size:16px;font-weight:700;border-radius:8px;
  border:1.5px solid transparent;cursor:pointer;line-height:1.2;text-transform:none;
  letter-spacing:normal;box-shadow:none}
.hn-btn-primary{background:var(--hn-orange);color:#fff}
.hn-btn-primary:hover:not(:disabled){background:#c94d21}
.hn-btn-primary:active:not(:disabled){transform:translateY(1px)}
.hn-btn-ghost{background:#fff;color:var(--hn-navy);border-color:var(--hn-line)}
.hn-btn-ghost:hover:not(:disabled){border-color:var(--hn-navy)}
.hn-btn:disabled{opacity:.55;cursor:default}
.hn-btn-sm{min-height:44px;font-size:13px;width:auto;padding:10px 8px}
.hn-btn-done{background:#f1fbf8;color:#0a3b31;border-color:var(--hn-teal)}
.hn-btn.hn-btn-done:disabled{opacity:1;cursor:default}
.hn-btn:focus-visible{outline:3px solid rgba(224,90,43,.35);outline-offset:1px}

.hn-divider{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin:14px 0;color:var(--hn-muted);
  font-size:13px;font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em}
.hn-divider::before,.hn-divider::after{content:"";flex:1;height:1px;background:var(--hn-line-soft)}

/* ---------- map stage ---------- */
.hn-stage{position:relative;border:1.5px solid var(--hn-line);border-radius:8px;
  overflow:hidden;background:#e8eef4;overscroll-behavior:contain}
.hn-stage.hn-active{border-color:var(--hn-orange);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(224,90,43,.16)}
#hn-map{height:320px;z-index:0;background:#e8eef4}
#hn-map:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--hn-navy);outline-offset:-3px}

.hn-stage.hn-full{position:fixed;inset:0;border-radius:0;border:0;z-index:100000;box-shadow:none}
.hn-stage.hn-full #hn-map{height:100%;height:100dvh}
body.hn-map-locked{overflow:hidden}

.hn-gate{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:500;display:flex;align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;background:rgba(11,37,69,.34);cursor:pointer;padding:16px;text-align:center}
.hn-gate:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--hn-orange);outline-offset:-5px}
.hn-gate span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;justify-content:center;
  background:#fff;color:var(--hn-navy);padding:14px 20px;border-radius:99px;
  font-weight:800;font-size:15px;line-height:1.3;box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(11,37,69,.28);max-width:280px}
.hn-gate span::before{content:"\2295";font-size:19px;line-height:1;color:var(--hn-orange)}
.hn-stage.hn-active .hn-gate{display:none}

.hn-crosshair{position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);
  z-index:450;pointer-events:none;width:64px;height:64px;display:none}
.hn-stage.hn-active .hn-crosshair{display:block}
.hn-crosshair::before,.hn-crosshair::after{content:"";position:absolute;background:var(--hn-navy);
  box-shadow:0 0 0 1.5px rgba(255,255,255,.9)}
.hn-crosshair::before{left:50%;top:0;width:2px;height:100%;margin-left:-1px}
.hn-crosshair::after{top:50%;left:0;height:2px;width:100%;margin-top:-1px}
.hn-crosshair i{position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;width:22px;height:22px;margin:-11px 0 0 -11px;
  border:3px solid var(--hn-orange);border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.55);
  box-shadow:0 0 0 1.5px rgba(255,255,255,.9)}

.hn-bar{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;z-index:600;display:none;gap:8px;padding:10px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.97);border-top:1px solid var(--hn-line-soft);
  padding-bottom:calc(10px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom))}
.hn-stage.hn-active .hn-bar{display:flex}
.hn-bar .hn-btn{flex:1;width:auto}
.hn-bar .hn-btn-icon{flex:0 0 auto;width:var(--hn-tap);padding:0}

.hn-tools{position:absolute;right:10px;top:10px;z-index:600;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
.hn-tools button{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:8px;border:1.5px solid var(--hn-line);
  background:#fff;cursor:pointer;font-size:18px;line-height:1;display:flex;align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;box-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(11,37,69,.16);padding:0;color:var(--hn-navy)}
.hn-tools button:hover{border-color:var(--hn-navy)}
.hn-stage:not(.hn-active) .hn-tools{display:none}
.hn-stage.hn-full .hn-tools{top:calc(10px + env(safe-area-inset-top))}

.hn-pill{display:none;position:absolute;z-index:600;left:62px;right:62px;
  top:calc(12px + env(safe-area-inset-top));margin:0;text-align:center;pointer-events:none}
.hn-stage.hn-full .hn-pill{display:block}
.hn-pill span{display:inline-block;background:rgba(11,37,69,.92);color:#fff;font-size:13.5px;
  font-weight:700;line-height:1.35;padding:9px 15px;border-radius:99px}

/* leaflet controls, sized for gloved hands */
#hn-map .leaflet-control-zoom{border:0 !important;box-shadow:none !important;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
#hn-map .leaflet-control-zoom a{width:44px !important;height:44px !important;
  line-height:44px !important;font-size:22px !important;
  border:1.5px solid var(--hn-line) !important;border-radius:8px !important;
  background:#fff;color:var(--hn-navy) !important;box-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(11,37,69,.16)}
#hn-map .leaflet-control-zoom a:hover{border-color:var(--hn-navy) !important}
.hn-stage:not(.hn-active) .leaflet-control-zoom{display:none}
#hn-map .leaflet-control-attribution{font-size:10px}
.hn-stage.hn-active .leaflet-bottom.leaflet-right{bottom:74px}
#hn-map .leaflet-top{margin-top:0}

.hn-pin{background:none;border:0}
.hn-pin svg{display:block;filter:drop-shadow(0 2px 3px rgba(11,37,69,.4))}

.hn-note{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--hn-muted);margin:8px 0 0;line-height:1.45}

/* ---------- provenance, suggestion, confidence ---------- */
.hn-addr-src{display:none;margin:0 0 12px;font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.45;color:var(--hn-muted)}
.hn-addr-src.hn-on{display:block}
.hn-addr-src b{color:var(--hn-ink);font-weight:700}

.hn-suggest{margin:0 0 12px;border:1.5px solid var(--hn-line);border-left:5px solid var(--hn-navy);
  border-radius:8px;background:#f7fafc;padding:13px 14px}
.hn-suggest-lbl{margin:0 0 3px;font-size:11px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.08em;
  text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--hn-muted)}
.hn-suggest-val{margin:0 0 11px;font-size:15px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.4;color:var(--hn-navy)}
.hn-suggest-actions{display:flex;gap:8px}
.hn-suggest-actions .hn-btn{flex:1 1 0;min-width:0;font-size:13.5px}
.hn-btn-accent{border-color:var(--hn-navy);color:var(--hn-navy)}

.hn-conf{border:1.5px solid var(--hn-line);border-left-width:5px;border-radius:8px;
  background:#fbfcfe;padding:12px 14px;transition:border-color .18s ease,background .18s ease}
.hn-conf[data-state="empty"]{border-left-color:var(--hn-line);color:var(--hn-muted)}
.hn-conf[data-state="address"]{border-left-color:var(--hn-navy);background:#f7fafc}
.hn-conf[data-state="reliable"]{border-left-color:var(--hn-teal);background:#f1fbf8}
.hn-conf[data-state="moderate"],.hn-conf[data-state="poor"]{border-left-color:var(--hn-warn);background:var(--hn-warn-bg)}
.hn-conf[data-state="rejected"],.hn-conf[data-state="conflict"]{border-left-color:var(--hn-danger);background:var(--hn-danger-bg)}
.hn-conf-top{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.hn-dot{width:11px;height:11px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--hn-line);align-self:center;flex:0 0 auto}
.hn-conf[data-state="address"] .hn-dot{background:var(--hn-navy)}
.hn-conf[data-state="reliable"] .hn-dot{background:var(--hn-teal)}
.hn-conf[data-state="moderate"] .hn-dot,.hn-conf[data-state="poor"] .hn-dot{background:var(--hn-warn)}
